tagline: 奥林巴斯胶片相机，1999 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于1999年推出的胶片相机。配备Olympus 28-75 mm, f4.7 - 9.9, 7 elements in 7 groups.。快门速度Programmed electronic, speeds: 4-1/500 sec.。使用IX240 (APS) cartridge film, 16.7 x 30.2mm frames.。感光度Automatic setting, range: ISO 25-3200.。Passive multi-autofocus system. Focus lock possible; range: 2 feet - Infinity.。

specs.镜头: Olympus 28-75 mm, f4.7 - 9.9, 7 elements in 7 groups.
specs.取景器: Real-image zoom viewfinder (with autofocus mark, close-up correction marks, autofocus indicator and flash indicator). C,H,P print type selection. With dioptric adjuster.
specs.对焦: Passive multi-autofocus system. Focus lock possible; range: 2 feet - Infinity.
specs.尺寸: w: 4.2 x h: 2.1 x d: 1.3 inches
specs.英文简介: The i-Zoom 75 is an APS film zoom-lens camera assembled in China for Olympus, announced in January 1999[https://web.archive.org/web/20030926032548/http://www.olympusamerica.com/cpg_section/cpg_pressdetails.asp?pressno=2 Olympus press release] (archived).
